caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular grandfather clock made primarily of a dark reddish-brown wood with visible grain patterns. The clock stands upright on a simple rectangular base, extending upward into a long, narrow body with a single door in its center, hinged on the right with a small, round doorknob on the left. The upper section of the clock features a square clock face set into a framed panel with an arched top. The clock face is a light, cream color and displays black Arabic numerals in a circular arrangement, with two black clock hands pointing to approximately 9:00. An additional small decorative design is visible above the numerals on the clock face. The background of the drawing is a neutral, beige tone, and the clock is centered vertically on the page.
title: Shaker Clock
